title: Sánchez in talks with coalition partners on reflection day: will he call elections in Spain?
content: The Spanish prime minister is weighing an early election after parliament rejected his housing plans, amid protests over the weekend. 29 November is the earliest possible date.
snippet: The Spanish prime minister is weighing an early election after parliament rejected his housing plans, amid protests over the weekend. 29 November is the earliest possible date.

title: Student protests in France: 400–500 schools fully or partially closed Monday
content: Another day of mobilisation is planned for Tuesday. By then, 400 to 500 secondary schools are expected to remain fully or partially closed, including 24 that have been “burned or vandalised”. The ministry also reports that 78 education staff have been injured since the movement began.

title: Merz makes surprise visit to Kyiv: Germany pledges further aid to Ukraine
content: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made a surprise visit to Kyiv on Sunday. Accompanied by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and representatives of German defence and energy companies, he aims to pledge further military and financial support for Ukraine.

title: Ceuta support T-shirt: €10 of its €35 price goes to self-described ‘patriotic’ movement Save Europe Act

title: Nearly 500,000 people protest in Madrid over Spain's housing crisis
content: Thousands take to the streets across Spain as protesters call for a general strike after parliament rejects two government housing decrees.

title: Showers and storms across Spain this weekend, floods kill 102-year-old woman
content: A 102-year-old woman has died and about 90 people were rescued in Madrigueras, Albacete, after floods dumped 142 l/m². Rain will persist, with a new storm possible in the west on Sunday.

title: Tension rises in Ceuta: two migrant children stabbed and bacteria-contaminated beach
content: Two migrant children were stabbed in a knife attack in Ceuta, while health authorities have found high levels of bacteria in the water at Trampolín beach, near a migrant camp. The migration crisis is forcing some people to sleep in garages, vehicles and on rooftops.

title: Russia 'tearing Kyiv apart', mayor says, as strikes paralyse traffic
content: Russian attacks on key infrastructure were "tearing Kyiv apart", the city's mayor said Friday, as strikes on a bridge linking the capital's east and west brought traffic to a standstill.

title: G7 agrees 100 million-barrel emergency oil release amid US pressure over diesel
content: The G7, led by France, announced the release of 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil after Trump threatened a ban of diesel exports.

title: French protests over school conditions spread as students set fires and put up blockades
